summary: Pender County steel lookout built by the CCC in 1936 with a lookout house added in 1937; no source found describes the site today.

facts.agency: North Carolina Division of Forest Resources

events.note: 120-foot steel tower constructed by the CCC in April 1936; construction completed by Camp P-68 on November 16, 1936
five-room frame house, 30 x 36 ft, completed in May 1937 as living quarters for the lookout

evidence.supports: 120-foot steel tower built by the CCC in April 1936; cost $2,088.00 funded through Emergency Conservation Works
evidence.quote: April 1936: A 120-foot steel tower was constructed by the Civilian Conservation Corps, the $2,088.00 cost was funded through the Emergency Conservation Works program.

evidence.supports: Camp P-68 completed the tower on November 16, 1936
evidence.quote: November 16, 1936: The construction of the tower was completed by members of Camp P-68 CCC.

evidence.supports: the work was reported in the Department of Conservation and Development 7th Biennial Report (1938)
evidence.quote: (Department of Conservation and Development - 7th Biennial Report - 1938)

evidence.supports: five-room frame house, 30 x 36 ft, completed for the lookout's living quarters in May 1937; labor by CCC Camp P-68
evidence.quote: May 26, 1937: A 30 x 36 foot five room frame house was completed for use as living quarters for the lookout. Labor was provided through the CCC Camp P-68.

evidence.supports: agency label for the Pender County entry
evidence.quote: Pender County - North Carolina Division of Forest Resources

evidence.supports: 2021 list still carries the name Wards Corner for a site in Pender County

notes_for_editor: Single detailed source: a web transcription of the state's Department of Conservation and Development biennial reports (7th, 1938). The reports themselves were not opened. The transcription gives a 120-foot steel tower; it does not say whether that height runs to the cab floor, so height_m is a structure height as printed. No source covers fate, notable fires or current condition. The house is the only staffing-related fact, and it does not prove a staffed tower. A business-directory search snippet lists a 'Wards Corner Fire Tower' at 8501 NC Highway 53 W, Burgaw, NC 28425; chamberofcommerce.com returned HTTP 403 to both fetch_text and WebFetch, so the listing was not read and is not used. A human could check it against NC Forest Service records. Access is not in any source, so no access fact is set; the record stays unknown.
